title: O-Laya: Fast, Ontology-Grounded System 1 Decisions with a Lean 4-Verified Axiom Projection Kernel and Inference-Free W3C PROV-O Workflow Replay
description: O-Laya (leio-decision) is a neuro-symbolic System 1 decision engine that conditions inference directly on an OWL 2 RL / RDF / SKOS ontology (TBox) at runtime. It combines hybrid lexical IDF and path-context bi-encoder Reciprocal Rank Fusion (google/embeddinggemma-2) with a Lean 4-verified axiom projection kernel (16 machine-checked theorems, zero sorry) that enforces subsumption monotonicity and child-closed disjointness exclusion, plus a declarative TBox-bound workflow compiler with inference-free W3C PROV-O JSON-LD replay across Python, Rust/WASM, and TypeScript/Node.js.
